workspace.name: Zentrik Open CRM
workspace.description: Public product workspace for the open-source CRM that grows through real usage, feedback, votes, source-grounded agent work, human review, and outcome checks.

portal.introCopy: Shape the open-source CRM built with its users. Vote on what matters, request what is missing, and watch signals become product work, releases, and outcome checks.

products.name: Zentrik Open CRM
products.description: The core open-source CRM product, including account work, signal capture, Codex-assisted workflows, local-first storage, hosted use, and the public feedback loop.

visibleIdeas.name: Zero-admin daily account board
visibleIdeas.description: Give small teams a focused daily view of accounts that need attention, why they matter, and which action is grounded in recent evidence.
visibleIdeas.publicWhy: The first users should get value before setting up a full sales process.

visibleIdeas.name: Source-grounded Codex follow-up drafts
visibleIdeas.description: Before Codex drafts a follow-up, show which account signals it used and let the human approve or edit the final customer-facing message.
visibleIdeas.publicWhy: The product should feel agentic without becoming opaque or unsafe.

visibleIdeas.name: Agent work log that shows what context was used
visibleIdeas.description: When Codex prepares a brief, follow-up, or product spec, show a compact trail of what it read, what it inferred, and what is waiting for human review.
visibleIdeas.publicWhy: Users should feel the product thinking with them, not acting as an opaque black box.

visibleIdeas.name: Local-first workspace with clean hosted upgrade path
visibleIdeas.description: Let users start with local browser or file-backed data, export their workspace, and move to hosted cloud only when they want convenience.
visibleIdeas.publicWhy: Open-source users need trust, ownership, and reversibility before they will put account data into a CRM.

visibleIdeas.name: Public Open CRM Buildroom
visibleIdeas.description: Show public-safe feedback, ideas under review, shipped changes, and outcome checks so users can see how their engagement changes the product.
visibleIdeas.publicWhy: The Buildroom is the clearest outward proof that the CRM is built with its users.

visibleIdeas.name: Spreadsheet import that creates immediate account memory
visibleIdeas.description: Import a simple account spreadsheet, detect useful columns, create accounts, and produce a first daily board without requiring CRM administration.
visibleIdeas.publicWhy: Many intended users start in spreadsheets and need a low-friction bridge.

visibleIdeas.name: Signal inbox for calls, tickets, reviews, and GitHub issues
visibleIdeas.description: Collect account and product signal from core systems, preserve source references, and help users decide what should become an account action or product idea.
visibleIdeas.publicWhy: The CRM becomes valuable when it notices important context before the user manually organizes it.

visibleIdeas.name: Relationship timeline with source confidence
visibleIdeas.description: Show what changed in an account over time, how confident the CRM is in each fact, and which source should be checked before acting.
visibleIdeas.publicWhy: Account memory is only useful when users can trust where it came from.

visibleIdeas.name: Open connector pattern for community integrations
visibleIdeas.description: Document and support a safe connector interface so contributors can add sources like Gmail, GitHub, support desks, calendar tools, and product analytics.
visibleIdeas.publicWhy: The open-source community should be able to expand the signal surface without compromising privacy boundaries.

portalAccounts.name: Open CRM Community
portalAccounts.purpose: Default public-feedback account for community members until a stronger account identity is available.

portalAccounts.name: Founder-Led Teams
portalAccounts.purpose: Segment account for founders, micro-SaaS builders, and small B2B operators.

portalAccounts.name: Consultants and Agencies
portalAccounts.purpose: Segment account for service teams managing client pipelines.

operatingRules: Treat portal submissions as product signal, not support commitments.
Review hidden submissions before public visibility.
Link accepted requests to source-grounded ideas in the Open CRM product workspace.
Use public-safe summaries only; never expose raw CRM records, emails, calls, or account notes.
Publish release updates with the evidence that caused the change and the outcome metric that will be reviewed.
Show public-safe agent work trails so users can understand how signals became work without exposing private data.

launchCopy.headline: The open-source CRM that gets better as you use it.
launchCopy.subheadline: Run it locally, request what is missing, vote on what matters, and watch your signal become product work, releases, and outcome checks.
